source.description: Example source: MediaStore already provides upload, ownership, storage, and reload. R1 adds a profile-photo interface using that existing engine.

outcomes.text: Users retain their profile photo after reload.

slices.title: Upload a profile photo
slices.behavior: A photo uploaded through the profile interface remains visible after reload.

acceptance.check: The same profile photo is visible after reload.
acceptance.observable: Upload a profile photo through the interface, reload, and see the same photo.
